decision.explanation: The provided documents contain contradictory assertions regarding Tadao Takashima's spouse. Document 1 (D1S2, D1S15) explicitly states he was married to 'Hanayo Sumi', citing confirmation from sources close to the couple and Ministry of Health records. Document 2 (D2S7, D2S21) explicitly states he married 'Evelyn Herbert Webb' in 1965, describing it as a transnational marriage. Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers where distinct valid namesakes or competing assertions exist without resolving them as errors, both names are included as they are directly supported by the respective source texts as the spouse of the same individual.
